title: pref/theme payload
description: UPSERT payload of pref/theme: the app theme the account chose, the same on every device it signs in on. Last writer wins. A DELETE with an empty payload goes back to the app's default. Serialized, at most 140 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

theme.description: dark, light, or system: follow the device's own light or dark setting, read on each device at display time.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
